text.tspan: 1. Collect logs from distributed services and hosts.
2. The system should support near real-time log ingestion.
3. It should accumulate the logs into one place for easy search.
4. Support full-text search, as well as time based search.
Each microservice is a virtual PC
that stores logs into local disc
Reads local log files and maintain offset
Alert hits when the specific type of logs is captured
Read data from S3 in specific interval
Reconcile the logs if Stream was failed
Trigger once in an hour/2 hours
If we use Filebeat, Kafka/Kinesis can be skipped
But it would be better to keep it for fan-out needs
Also, Filebeat cannot write to more than one source at a time.
So, to write in S3 and Logstash together, a stream is needed.
Every consumer will access a respective broker; each broker can have multiple topics.
In case of SMS, Email, WhatsApp, Push notifications, we will have 3rd party services integrated, i.e., Kaleyra, Exotel, AWS SES, SendGrid, FCS, APN, etc.
In case of Webhook, we willl be directly calling the Webhook API we have configured in the Template table with the parameters we are getting from client.
Each topic will have retries and DLQ
If msg is not sent in 1st attempt, it will retry
After all configured retry attempts, it will push to DLQ
Consider same operations being performed with every consumer inside every consumer group
